comparison.objective: Depress a panic bar, turn its dogging cam with a hex key, remove the key, and leave the latch retracted.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring-loaded bar at full travel while inserting and quarter-turning one key; it lacks coupled screw-and-nut tools and countertorque on an adjustable stop.
comparison.success_condition: Cam caught near 90 degrees, bar and latch retained down, key removed, and mechanism released; all six listed spec versions were considered.
comparison.reason: This is the closest simultaneous hold-and-turn record, but it tests conditional cam engagement under bar depression rather than locking a continuously adjusted stop without drift and cycling it.
